title: Tsuredure Children
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A four-panel romantic comedy following many couples at one high school as they fumble through confessions and early relationships. Storylines interlock through shared friends: shy pairs who can't say 'I love you', a girl who confesses in riddles, a couple attempting their first time, and a boy who pressures a girl into dating after catching her smoking.
life_message: It holds up honesty about your feelings, however awkward, as the way to real connection.
